Subject: Update on Your Department Budget Request

Dear [Name],

Thank you for submitting your request for a budget increase. After careful review, we have decided not to approve the increase at this time, as the current justification does not fully align with the company’s financial strategy.

However, we are open to reconsidering your proposal. If you would like to resubmit, please provide a more detailed explanation along with concrete examples of the anticipated benefits. This additional context will help us better understand the value and impact of your request.

Please let me know if you have any questions or need further guidance.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]

Mount Olympus
